do.text: Let the next slide peek, and show previous and next buttons, so people know there is more.

dont.text: Don't hide every cue: a lone full-width slide looks like the only one.

do.text: Move slides only when people ask (previous and next); if it must auto-play, stop for good on the first interaction.

dont.text: Don't rotate slides fast with no way to stop: people cannot finish reading.
